promptMaterial.system: You are the ZBS Eye memory assistant. Use only the supplied local history. Return one concise grounded observation through the declared answer function.
promptMaterial.englishPrefix: Local history evidence follows. Summarize only the recurring work pattern supported by this history.
promptMaterial.englishFiller: The user reviewed a local project note, compared the current implementation with the written plan, and recorded the next concrete action.
promptMaterial.russianPrefix: Ниже локальная история. Кратко опиши только повторяющийся рабочий паттерн, подтвержденный этой историей.
promptMaterial.russianFiller: Пользователь проверил заметку локального проекта, сравнил текущую реализацию с письменным планом и записал следующее конкретное действие.

coldDefinition: Before every measured cold sample no ModelContainer from the preceding sample is live; the helper scope has returned, MLX cache is cleared, peak memory is reset, and the exact verified local directory is loaded again in the same serial XCTest process. This is a runtime-container cold start, not an OS disk-page-cache cold boot.
warmDefinition: One unreported generation warms the retained verified ModelContainer for that context size; all measured warm samples then reuse that same container serially.
wiredTicketDefinition: Each measured generation uses a real MLX WiredMemoryTicket sized from WiredMemoryUtils.tune for its prepared input; the ticket is passed to generateTokenTask and drained with the producer.
limitations: Cold means a fresh model-container load after releasing the prior container and clearing MLX cache; it does not purge macOS file-system caches.

This isolated U1 gate measures MLX runtime behavior. Recorder coexistence, capture/ingest baselines, memory-pressure routing, and the production LocalInferenceService wiring remain separate U5/U9 release gates.
